notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a number of creature tokens equal to its power.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk
uses.cardState: as The Incredible Hulk and without summoning sickness
